status: integrated mechanism experiment; not historical inference

sourced.note: Fitted demographic reference, not independent historical validation; full register in sources.json

scenarioAssumptions.initialization: Each age-sex cohort floor(count/10), distributed round-robin among six groups on six southwest land sites; 426 initial people
scenarioAssumptions.resources: Uniform site budgets in person-years, not calories; renewal user parameter 10–200 per site/year; storage cap 3 times renewal
scenarioAssumptions.renewalTiming: Before annual consumption; add min(renewal, storage capacity minus current stock)
scenarioAssumptions.consumption: One abstract budget unit per person per annual step. Residents share local stock and deficits proportionally. At departure, a group withdraws min(available stock, current people * ceil(travel duration)) into carried inventory. Travelers consume only that inventory, never later departure-site renewal. Whole-year transit charging includes the arrival step. Leftovers deposit at arrival, with storage overflow recorded as discarded. Transport/storage capacity is not calibrated; there is no starvation or fecundity response.
scenarioAssumptions.destinationChoice: If current (stock + renewal)/claimed population <1.5, evaluate directly connected sites within12km; score=(stock + renewal)/(claimed population + group people)/(1 + route cost/travel budget); relocate only if score exceeds local ratio by0.05. Claims include residents and travelers assigned to that destination. Annual ID priority rotates. This is a heuristic, not fitted human behavior.
scenarioAssumptions.travelCost: distance_km + 4 * total absolute elevation change_km, sampled every <=0.25km on resampled elevation. Symmetric sensitivity rule, not validated physiological cost.
scenarioAssumptions.travelTime: cost / residential travel budget (1–40 km-equivalent/year); not literal daily walking speed
scenarioAssumptions.barrier: All cells touched by a segment must be positive elevation; unknowns and window exterior blocked. Present-day conservative elevation mask, not a verified water/palaeoland map.
scenarioAssumptions.groupFission: Resident group >90 people splits half of each cohort (integer floor), with count conservation. No kinship, partner or family rules; max512 groups software bound.
scenarioAssumptions.sites: 550 irregular candidate sites, minimum3km spacing. They are numerical decision sites, not reconstructed settlements. Local point locations remain continuous during transit.
scenarioAssumptions.time: 100 elapsed years, no BP date; annual decisions/demography, exact scheduled arrival time, continuous route interpolation
scenarioAssumptions.demography: Same modern rates in all habitats, including travelers. No pregnancy, spacing, famine or partner state; 0.5 female birth probability. Annual newborn convention retained.

requiredBeforeHistoricalUse: Resource and freshwater evidence and calibration
Grid/site density convergence and directional bias experiments
Independent archaeological observation model and holdout validation
verification: checks.json plus 35 Rust unit tests. Resource identity includes site stock, carried stock, consumption and discarded overflow. Accounting correctness is not empirical validation.
